description.value: Moguls Coffee is Whistler's original independent coffee house, locally owned and operated since 1992 in the heart of Whistler Village at Village Square. It serves a full menu of espresso drinks, fresh-made breakfast wraps, sandwiches, and vegan smoothies, sourcing its beans from Agro, a Vancouver family roastery focused on organic and sustainable farming. As one of the few remaining independent cafés in Whistler, it has deep community roots and makes a welcoming stop for cyclists passing through the village core.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (16 spaces) at 51m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully available and provides the address (4204 Village Square #202, Whistler, BC V8E 1H5) and phone (604-932-4845) not present in OSM. The menu pages confirm counter-service coffee and food, with multiple items explicitly labeled vegan and gluten-free, and the café format implies takeout as the primary service mode. No bike-specific amenities (racks, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established independent café in Whistler Village with a substantial food menu including vegan/GF options — a practical and welcoming stop for touring cyclists moving through the village.
